mapper.sql: v.svc_id, v.server_id, v.list_no, v.group_no, v.level_no, v.svc_nm, v.account_nm, v.script_path, v.script_arg, v.cmds, v.state_cd, v.pid, v.state_dt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_service v WHERE v.server_id = #{serverId} ORDER BY v.list_no, v.svc_id
SELECT FROM tb_service v ORDER BY v.server_id, v.list_no, v.svc_id
SELECT v.server_id AS server_id, COUNT(*) AS svc_cnt FROM tb_service v GROUP BY v.server_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_service ( server_id, list_no, group_no, level_no, svc_nm, account_nm, script_path, script_arg, cmds, state_cd, pid, state_dt, reg_dt, upd_dt ) VALUES ( #{serverId}, #{listNo}, #{groupNo}, #{levelNo}, #{svcNm}, #{accountNm}, #{scriptPath}, #{scriptArg, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cmds}, 'UNKNOWN', NULL, NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_service SET list_no = #{listNo}, svc_nm = #{svcNm}, group_no = #{groupNo}, level_no = #{levelNo}, account_nm = #{accountNm}, script_path = #{scriptPath}, script_arg = #{scriptArg, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, cmds = #{cmds}, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE svc_id = #{svcId}

choose.when: SELECT h.svc_id, h.server_id, v.svc_nm, h.collect_dt, h.cpu_pct, h.mem_pct, h.running_yn FROM tb_service_metric_hist h INNER JOIN tb_service v ON v.svc_id = h.svc_id WHERE h.collect_dt >= dateadd(hh, -24, getdate()) ORDER BY h.server_id, h.svc_id, h.collect_dt, h.hist_id
choose.otherwise: SELECT t.svc_id, t.server_id, t.svc_nm, t.collect_dt, t.cpu_pct, t.mem_pct, t.running_yn FROM (SELECT h.svc_id, h.server_id, v.svc_nm, h.collect_dt, h.cpu_pct, h.mem_pct, h.running_yn, h.hist_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY h.svc_id ORDER BY h.collect_dt DESC, h.hist_id DESC) AS rn FROM tb_service_metric_hist h INNER JOIN tb_service v ON v.svc_id = h.svc_id) t WHERE t.rn <= #{points} ORDER BY t.server_id, t.svc_id, t.collect_dt, t.hist_id

mapper.update: UPDATE tb_service SET state_cd = 'UNKNOWN', pid = NULL, state_dt = NULL, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE server_id = #{serverId}
mapper.sql: c.cmd_id, c.server_id, c.target, c.cmd_cd, c.state_cd, c.req_user, c.req_dt, c.sent_dt, c.end_dt, c.exit_cd, c.result_msg
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_service_cmd (server_id, target, cmd_cd, state_cd, req_user, req_dt) VALUES (#{serverId}, #{target}, #{cmdCd}, 'REQUESTED', #{reqUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

choose.otherwise: SELECT t.cmd_id, t.server_id, t.target, t.cmd_cd, t.state_cd, t.req_user, t.req_dt, t.sent_dt, t.end_dt, t.exit_cd, t.result_msg FROM (SELECT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.cmd_id DESC) AS rn FROM tb_service_cmd c WHERE c.server_id = #{serverId}) t WHERE t.rn <= #{rows} ORDER BY t.cmd_id DESC

mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_service_cmd c WHERE c.server_id = #{serverId} AND c.state_cd = 'REQUESTED' ORDER BY c.cmd_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_service_cmd c WHERE c.server_id = #{serverId} AND c.state_cd IN ('REQUESTED', 'SENT')
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_service_cmd SET state_cd = 'SENT', sent_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE cmd_id = #{cmdId} AND state_cd = 'REQUESTED'

UPDATE tb_service_cmd SET state_cd = #{stateCd}, exit_cd = #{exitCd}, result_msg = #{resultMsg, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, end_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE server_id = #{serverId} AND cmd_id = #{cmdId} AND state_cd = 'SENT'
UPDATE tb_service_cmd SET state_cd = 'EXPIRED', end_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE (state_cd = 'REQUESTED' AND req_dt < #{requestedBefore}) OR (state_cd = 'SENT' AND sent_dt < #{sentBefore})
